candidates.hypothesis: Unifying allocator-first synchronous swapin, single-lock order-0 allocation in mm/swap_state.c and mm/memory.c, adaptive stride streak-gating requiring 2+ contiguous hits before expanding window beyond 1, and decoupled asynchronous zswap prefetch offloading speculative decompression to a background workqueue eliminates synchronous fault stalling and random swap cache thrashing, achieving a -6% to -9% geomean latency improvement across sequential and random workloads without regressions or correctness violations.

mechanism.claim: In mm/memory.c and mm/swap_state.c, synchronous swap devices bypass preliminary cache lookups and enter allocator-first swapin with single-lock order-0 allocation, readahead window expansion is gated on 2+ contiguous hits with immediate window collapse to 1 on stride disruptions, and speculative zswap decompression is offloaded to a background workqueue while the faulting thread returns immediately after synchronous order-0 load.
mechanism.falsifier: Exact-tree review shows lost lifetime protection, incorrect slot conflict handling, or broken cache lookup fallback. Correctness, metadata spread <1%, and calibrated fast-tier screen independently gate execution.

state.reason: Integrates streak-gating state machine and asynchronous zswap prefetch workqueue.

lifetime.reason: Page and swap slot references acquired and released synchronously with matching put_swap_device balances.

locking.reason: Single-lock order-0 swapcache allocation eliminates lock bounce under swap_address_lock.

error_paths.reason: Non-blocking allocations drop abandoned slots cleanly without memory leaks or fault path aborts.

configuration.reason: Transparently active under kernel swapin without requiring new sysctl or sysfs configuration.

interfaces.reason: Kernel swap fault handler and readahead function interface contracts are strictly preserved.

memory_cost.reason: Allocates minimal short-lived order-0 batch buffers under GFP_NOWAIT without permanent memory footprint.
